description: A React component 'PromptInfoView' in TypeScript that displays detailed information about a prompt, including metadata, template, and raw API response. It handles fetching data, copying to clipboard, and prompt deletion with confirmation.

classes.name: PromptInfoView
classes.description: A React functional component that displays detailed prompt information, manages state related to prompt data, handles fetch, delete, and copy actions, and renders a tabbed UI for different prompt views.

methods.name: fetchPromptInfo
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches prompt information from backend and updates component state.

methods.name: formatDate
methods.description: Formats a date string into a locale-specific string or returns '-' if input is undefined.

methods.name: copyToClipboard
methods.description: Copies provided text to clipboard and shows user feedback.

methods.name: handleDeleteClick
methods.description: Triggers the display of delete confirmation modal.

methods.name: handleDeleteConfirm
methods.description: Performs prompt deletion via API call, handles success/failure, and updates UI accordingly.

methods.name: handleDeleteCancel
methods.description: Closes the delete confirmation modal without action.
